mapper.select: SELECT q.id AS question_id, q.knowledge_point_id, q.score AS total_score, COALESCE(sa.earned_score, 0) AS earned_score FROM questions q LEFT JOIN student_answers sa ON q.id = sa.question_id AND sa.assignment_submission_id = #{submissionId} WHERE q.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND q.knowledge_point_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT q.id AS question_id, q.knowledge_point_id, q.score AS total_score, COALESCE(sa.earned_score, 0) AS earned_score FROM questions q LEFT JOIN student_answers sa ON q.id = sa.question_id AND sa.exam_submission_id = #{submissionId} WHERE q.exam_id = #{examId} AND q.knowledge_point_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT kp.id FROM knowledge_points kp JOIN assignment_knowledge_points akp ON kp.id = akp.knowledge_point_id WHERE akp.assignment_id = #{assignmentId}
SELECT kp.id FROM knowledge_points kp JOIN exam_knowledge_points ekp ON kp.id = ekp.knowledge_point_id WHERE ekp.exam_id = #{examId}
